Results.ReviewText: Heats up so fast . Have the quick connect to use on the motor home . Can’t ask for a better grill
Results.Title: Excellent for camping

Results.ReviewText:
We had one without the side trays and we wore it out. So, when we decided to get a new one we went with one that had trays and it is purple!  I 
We love it.
Results.Title: I love the side trays!

Results.ReviewText: I've only used it twice since I purchased it and am still trying to get comfortable with the heat control.
Results.Title: I've wanted one for years!

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill mainly for tailgating at sporting events. It has been great! Easy to transport, heats up quickly, and is easy to clean!
Results.Title: Great features and easy to clean!

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this grill at Home Depot 2 months ago and I just started using it a couple weeks ago.  I had a Weber Genesis but sold it because we sold our home and move into an apartment and this grill cooks just as well, maybe even better.  I would recommend purchasing this grill.
Results.Title: Looks great!

Results.ReviewText: We have really enjoyed our Weber Q 1200.  It is highly portable and has provided excellent grilling at several picnic sites.  Clean up is super easy and we have especially enjoyed the variety of recipes on the Weber website.
Results.Title: Easy set up and use

Results.ReviewText: Great grill with few exceptions. The flip-out trays are very slippery. If you place a plate on them, it will likely slide off. Also, trying to use a low heat setting is quite difficult. I had to adjust the knob toward the off position to gain a very low setting. Otherwise, the build quality and cooking ability is great. We also bought the griddle to use for pancakes and such. Love it!
Results.Title: Great grill for camping.

Results.ReviewText: This grill has been amazing. Great to pack up in the trunk and take to the beach,park,camping etc.  We even use it at home alot
Results.Title: IF YOU DONT HAVE ONE, YOU SHOULD!

Results.ReviewText: I bought this to replace an old table top grill.  The price made me reluctant so I read all the reviews and got the Q.  At first I was disappointed with the flame output - it seemed really low.  But I quickly found out that was VERY deceiving.  This grill gets HOT. and it does it FAST.  I have cooked chicken, pork, seafood, veggies, and steak on this grill and it worked perfectly for every type of food.  Highly recommended.  Worth every penny.
Results.Title: Just WOW

Results.ReviewText:
This grill is of very high quality.  I bought the optional stand which also works well.  Several comments:  
1)  This grill doesn't seem to have it's own gas shutoff value, relying on the shut-off valve on the tank.  Thus, I don't think I could use it with the small gas canisters.  
2)  The grilling surface is two high quality cast or forged surfaces.  They are far more difficult to clean than the wire grates of my other Weber grills on which I used a wire brush.  I end up removing the grilling surface to clean them in the kitchen before every use.
Results.Title: Good Quality

Results.ReviewText: Perfect size and easy to clean.  Will definitely recommend to friends.
Results.Title: No regrets!

Results.ReviewText: This is the first time I’m enjoying grilling.  The Weber Grill is easy to setup and makes grilling a pleasure.  More Summer Fun!!
Results.Title: Perfect Size

Results.ReviewText: I’ve had this little Q for about three or four months and have used it at least weekly.  It works fine for grilling a steak or burgers, chicken wings, etc.  The challenge is with the grates; there is simply not enough “fire power” to, at the end of the cooking time, burn off any marinade/sauce residue.  There is, however, sufficient “fire power” to bake such residue into a thick coating over the “non-stick” surface on the iron grates.  As such, the grates are nearly impossible to keep clean.  Other than that, for limited basic grilling duty, the Q works fine.  For the sake of having a larger grilling surface area, I do wish the Q2000 series had been readily available in local stores, and would be available in basic Weber black.
Results.Title: Sufficient in some respects, but not all

Results.ReviewText: I have been grilling since my early twenties, 50+ yrs.  I have used charcoal, gas, and smokers.  I have to say this is the best grill I have ever used!  It is the perfect size.  Grill capacity/space for 2 - 14 burgers, 2 - 8 pcs chicken breast.  Easy to clean, compact storage, cover fits great.  I did experience difficulty with cleaning the burner, but Customer Service helped out with the solution.
Results.Title: Best grill ever owned!

Results.ReviewText: Bought for traveling and it works well as do all Weber I have.
Results.Title: Works great

Results.ReviewText: Small unit with surprising power. Quality built for a long life. Great portability for our storage in our RV.
Results.Title: Gets it done.

Results.ReviewText: I have a Weber Performer that I love but my wife was not comfortable starting the charcoal even though it’s easy as could be and thought it took too long to get a fire ready. With it just being the two of us now I thought about it and it made sense to get something she’d be happy with and had a smaller footprint. So after some research I settled on the Q1200 and moved my performer off the deck to a concrete slab below the deck and put the Q on a shelf freeing up floor space. This little grill performs great and efficiently and is good looking. We love it and couldn’t be happier with the purchase. The only drawback is things will stick if you don’t use Weber grill spray.
Results.Title: Very efficient and convenient

Results.ReviewText: Love it. So happy I bought this grill. So easy to run. Cleans nice too.
Results.Title: Super fun grill.

Results.ReviewText: Absolutely love my grill perfect for our camping/ boating trips!!!!
Results.Title: Great features

Results.ReviewText: I was very disappointed with the grill and returned it to Lowes. The construction was good and what I would expect from Weber. The temperature control was absolutely useless. It didn’t matter where you set the adjustment it would not change from a very high temp. I called the help line and was told it would work well for burgers and steaks at that temp. I was sent a replacement valve and it was even worse. I have had cheaper grills that worked better. Not what I would expect from Weber.
Results.Title: Very disappointed

Results.ReviewText: I have had the grill for a few months now. A full 16 oz can of propane lasts me a week or more.  I tested a full can and it lasted about three hours on high heat.
Results.Title: Cook time card

Results.ReviewText: The grill is a quality product, easy to clean and handle, and has lived up to expectations. 12-15 min of warmup, then it does its job! It's portable and efficient!
Results.Title: What I hoped for!

Results.ReviewText: Works okay but I am using it with my 5lb propane tank and find I can't keep the heat below 400 + without leaving the lid up all the time.
Results.Title: heating Issue

Results.ReviewText: Temp control good. Have had no problems. Very handy.
Results.Title: Great for RVing

Results.ReviewText: This is the second grill I bought because my wife loved the first one so much. If you are not into full time barbecuing then this grill will work for most of your needs. Fast cleanups and reasonable heat production
Results.Title: Great compact Grill

Results.ReviewText: Bought one...lavender...for house in desert.  Loved it so much, bought one for the house in France.

Results.ReviewText: I recently purchased the 1200 and I love it. The color choice was great, I got orange my favorite color.  I would recommend anyone to take the plunge if they’re considering one. I will add another for my home in the winter.
Results.Title: Great new grill

Results.ReviewText: The grill is easy to use and cooks and cleans up well.

Results.ReviewText: Great purchase, we use it when we camp! I have tried other portable grills and this one is very solid, grill surface is excellent and temperature gauge is a bonus.

I like grilled seafood and am looking forward to using this grill for that as the grates on this model will accomodate fish much better than my charcoal grill. Thanks Weber for a great product!
Results.Title: Very Nice ..Small but mighty

Results.ReviewText: We've had a dozen grills over the years, big and small, cheap and expensive.  This little Weber grill is the very best grill we've ever bought.  I will never go back to a big patio grill.  No need to.  We even bought one for my parents anniversary.  They love it too.
Results.Title: Best grill we have ever had!

Results.ReviewText: We bought this bbq on the spur of the moment  and so glad we did. It is small enough to go anywhere . The heat stays very  stable and it cooks evenly. Love this bbq.
Results.Title: Great cooking experience

Results.ReviewText: I love the size, the temperature control, the side tables.
Results.Title: Perfect size for RV.

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this size grill for my parents who are elderly to be able to enjoy cooking outside and be able to change the small propane tank . They live it and easy to clean and store away .
Results.Title: Weber grill

Results.ReviewText: Heats up quick, very even heat, easy to clean!  What’ else can you say it’s a Weber!
Results.Title: Great little grill!

Results.ReviewText: bought the Q1200 and the negatives so far are1. propane bottle is hard to screw in because the handle is in the way. you have to apply pressure to the handle to allow the threads to line up. 2. the temp control is lacking. In all of the  4 uses, the temp dial was at its lowest and the temp would only go down to 375 or 450 and varied each time it was used, unless one propped open the lid. max will go over 500, but one should be able to get a lower temp out of it. A standard small bottle of propane was used. Otherwise cleanup was good, the size is good for camping, just wish temp could be adjusted to 200/250 degrees
Results.Title: good product but

Results.ReviewText: We really like our new Q 1200 Gas Grill. It's ideal for the two of us and easy to handle allowing us to take it with us on trips. The 1 pound tanks offer a lot of cooking for the size and makes portability much easier. The electric start is true to form every single time so never a hassle getting things started. We also purchase the griddle grille and find this to be a definite asset for cooking and is helpful at keeping things clean. The grilles and gridle heat up quickly and provide good even cooking temperatures.
Results.Title: Ideal for the two of us

Results.ReviewText: In preparation for retirement we sold our home of 15 years. We had not yet found our retirement home so we moved into an apartment while we looked for one. I grill out 3-4 times a week. So we had to get an interim solution. Rather than buy a junky grill that we would throw away when we moved we bought the Weber Q1200 so we could use it as a portable when we got to our new home. I t has more than exceeded our expectations. It can cook nearly as well as my old Genesis. The only limitation is the size. It is easy to clean and store. I use it with an adapter for a full size LP tank. Highly recommend.
Results.Title: Great portable grill

Results.ReviewText: I bought this a month ago and cooked on several times now. Only issue I had is the heat could turn down lower. Other than that I love it. The side wings are large enough to keep your cooking items nearby.
Results.Title: Well made

Results.ReviewText: I bought this for camping.  It is nice size and works great.
Results.Title: great unit

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this weekend for a four day camping trip and immediately fell in love.  I cooked steaks, brats and polish sausage on three different evenings and all came out perfectly.  Don't waste your money on cheap imitations, buy this one NOW.  It is the perfect car/RV camping grill.
Results.Title: The perfect camping grill

Results.ReviewText: This is my second small Webber grill, and it is great for cooking small meals. It has a build in temperature gage which I find to be very helpful. I have mine on a Webber stand which folds for storage. The grill plates are substantial, unlike most other compact grills.

Results.Title: Great features.

Results.ReviewText: Needed a portable grill.  Have Owned several Weber grills over the years so the choice was easy.
Results.Title: Perfect portable grill

Results.Title: Perfect size for my needs.

Results.Title: two burners would be better

Results.ReviewText: Always had the original charcoal Weber but I Love this gas grill.  Was unsure which size would be suitable but Q1200 has ample space for one or for many - grilling is even across, simple and accurate put-together instructions and nice to have 'recommended cooking temp card'.  So happy with this purchase.
Results.Title: Well worth it

Results.ReviewText:
Form and function is everything I expected.
Built to last with high quality components and looks to match.
Worth the money spent and should last for years. Cast iron grates for grill marks on meats are easy to remove and clean, keep drippings off of the burners-porcelain coated also.
Portable cart was a good addition for securely attaching grill and putting it at the right height to cook and wheel around with security, or simply put on a picnic table.
Fat.drippings collected in disposable aluminum pan are very affordable and available everywhere. Very happy with this grill!
Results.Title: Excellent engineering top quality

Results.ReviewText: Bought this grill to camp with. I’ve grilled on it everyday since purchase. Great size for the girlfriend and I. Excellent heat control. Sturdy. Will be buying the table shortly to camp with. Couldn’t be happier.
Results.Title: Great little grill.

Results.ReviewText: we love this grill ...we live very close to the ocean and have real issues with rust...even stainless steel grills are destroyed within just a few years ...this grill has lasted 4 years  with out any issues...the stand did rust out last year but the grill lives on ..this was the best deal in grill we have gotten in last 12 years
Results.Title: Engineering Inspector/Project Coordinator

Results.ReviewText: I couldn’t be more pleased than with my choice to purchase the Weber Q 1200 gas grill. I had difficulty finding it locally so I considered purchasing one of 3 other brands. I’m glad I stuck with my search and bought the Weber. We use it every day to grill all types of quality meats, poultry and fish. I’m 65 years old and i’ve never had a grill that provides such consistent results. It is a quality grill that is easy to light, preheats quickly, capable of very high temperatures when needed and, easy to clean. It has “big grill” features in a compact size. We’ve used it for cooking for guests without a problem. It takes up a very small footprint on our patio. I love this Weber!
Results.Title: GREAT GRILL!

Results.ReviewText: I needed a small gas grill for my RV. Got an extra long gas hose in order to use the RV's propane tanks. Grill works just like my Weber Genisis, just smaller. Love it!
Results.Title: Perfect!

Results.ReviewText: I purchased one of these when they first came out many years ago. Sadly it was damaged in a move but, I loved it so much, I purchased another. The perfect size for 1-4 people! Grills to perfection!
Results.Title: Perfect

Results.ReviewText: It is so easy to use. I absolutely love it. Cooks quick and is easy to clean.
Results.Title: Quicj and Easy To Use

Results.ReviewText: We've been a Weber customer for years using coal kettle grills through several propane models. The Q1200 is used as we travel in a travel trailer. Same great construction quality.  Lights reliably and works well except occasionally in some windy conditions. Heats well but is limited due to the single burner design.  Meets the needs of the basic grilling function
Results.Title: Decent small grill

Results.ReviewText: The Weber 1200 has to be the most convenient Grill in every aspect perfect temperature control, easy to clean up, convenient to carry in small places example RVs. This is the best grill I have ever purchased.
Results.Title: Outstanding Grill

Results.ReviewText: I love the product, but it would be nice if it came with a caring bag!
Results.Title: Hi performance

Results.ReviewText: I bought this a month ago and so happy with my First Weber Purchase. We had a big grill before but when we moved Our current deck was much smaller. So we decide to purchase the Weber Grill Q1200. It works perfect for the 3 of us. I was very surprised by how many meals we cooked using the small tank. I love it that we can just pack it up and take it with us. SO glad I finally made my weber purchase
Results.Title: Awesome Grill

Results.ReviewText: Before I knew this grill existed I bought a Coleman travel grill which is big and heavy and has metal catch trays that are a nightmare to clean. I bought the Q1200 after seeing a coworker’s and I’m convinced it is the best portable grill in the market. It’s light and compact and utilizes disposable grease trays which I think is perfect for camping. It has a grill surface large enough to cook for my whole family at one time. I use for camping and road trips but this grill could be used as a home grill with the option for an adapter to a larger fuel tank.
Results.Title: Great Features

Results.ReviewText: After reading the reviews for the Weber Q1200 I decided to purchase one to use while camping. The size was perfect for packing around with us. The grill does cook fast and hot. Hamburgers were cooked thru and very juicy. My wife said I cooked some of the best steaks I've ever cooked. The steaks seared very fast and left the steaks cooked perfect and juicy. We have also cooked bacon wrapped jalapeño peppers , Chicken Grillers, Baked potatoes, and Corn on the cob !  Clean up was fast and easy with the replaceable drip tray in the bottom of the grill.  Very well made ! Well worth the investment.
Results.Title: Great Camping Grill !

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill to replace a Coleman Roadtrip for use with my RV.  The Weber is the perfect size for traveling and lightweight. The cooking surface heats evenly and the griddle option is a must have for us.  Very happy with my new grill.
Results.Title: Terrific Portable Grill

Results.ReviewText: I bought this several months ago and I'm so glad that I did it is an exceptionally wonderful Grill and perfect for camping
Results.Title: Love this grill !

Results.ReviewText: We got a deal at Lowe’s since this was on the floor. Generally works great. The initial hook-up of the small disposable propane tank was tough since the frame gets in the way a bit but it’s plastic and you can make it fit relatively easily once you figure it out. Except for that minor issue the grill has worked like a champ.
Results.Title: Nice grill!

Results.Title: Nice size

Results.ReviewText: This is my second one. I had the 1000 for about 5 years. Now with the 1200 it’s a little bigger and does a fantastic job. Food always cooks good and tastes great. No problems . The only problem with the 1000 the reg broke while we where traveling. Highly recommended I like 1200 better though.
Results.Title: Great BBQ for my RV

Results.ReviewText: Best grill for 1-2 people.  The size is perfect and it grills evenly.
Results.Title: Right size grill

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill to replace my existing Weber Q (which I had used for many years and was very happy with, it just finally wore out after about 12 years) but to my surprise the new grill I purchased was much much smaller, I guess I didn’t realize and it certainly wasn’t clear packaging that this was a baby Q compared to my original. So be careful with the 1200 model it certainly isn’t nearly as useful as the original.
Results.Title: Small Small Small

Results.ReviewText: We purchased this grill to take camping and it is working out nicely. We have a Weber Spirit grill at home and love it as well.
Results.Title: cooks evenly and easy clean up

Results.ReviewText:
This is my second “Q” I had the 100 first, liked it too but plane cast iron was a chore, these new grates are awesome. The size is perfect for me and if I can wear it out I will buy another.

I also have a Webber Smokie mountain smoker and a jumbo joe. (Both awesome too) to fill all my needs.
Results.Title: The best!

Results.ReviewText: We bought this to go camping and it is great for hauling due to it is small enough to put anywhere. I is big enough to do any foods we cook camping. Love this little grill
Results.Title: great little grill

Results.ReviewText: I’ve had it a year and use it all the time. Great purchase. Cooks fast.
Results.Title: Great grille.

Results.ReviewText: I BOUGHT THIS TO REPLACE MY GRILL WE USE WHEN WE GO RVING. THIS IS SO MUCH BETTER THAN MY OLD ONE (EVEN WHEN IT WAS NEW). I LOVE ALL OF THE FEATURES. THE ONLY SLIGHT DEFECT IS THE SHALL GAS CYLINDERS ARE A  LITTLE TIGHT FIT PUTTING THEM ON THE VALVE BUT IS NOT THAT BAD. I LOVE THIS GRILL!
Results.Title: GREAT GRILL

Results.ReviewText: finally...easily clean up grille grates! and a thermostat
Results.Title: finally...great little grille

Results.ReviewText: I like this grill because it is easy to use,  performs well and looks great!
Results.Title: Love it!

Results.ReviewText: This grill is perfect for me and of course it’s a Weber!
Results.Title: Simple and clean...

Results.ReviewText:
I have a weber charcoal (22" performer) grill. But I was looking for something small and handy I can power up fast for small meals. This Q1200 is just perfect!
I can grill pork chops, sausages or veggies with out the need to light the charcoal grill.  So sausages, bacon, small pieces of meat I am using the Q1200. For more fancy stuff..I power up the charcoal.
But Pls note, it fits perfectly up to 6 burgers.
Strongly recommended
Results.Title: Small but powerful enough

Results.ReviewText: I have went through many grills in my lifetime and I finally found the one that I really like.  easy to use, and built with quality and care.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Wow! This thing rocks!! I never write reviews but I’ve been telling everyone about this compact, portable, cheap, reliable, amazing grill. Seriously it’s all you need. Buy one!!!
Results.Title: Best money I’ve spent in years!!!

Results.ReviewText: I've had the grill about 2 months and it exceeds my expectations I live in a condo and every time I use the grill I'm amazed how easy it is use and to move about and the burgers are delicious
Results.Title: great small grill

Results.ReviewText: Never wanted to spend that much for a grill, but you get what you pay for. This grill is fantastic, even heat distribution, easy to light and clean. Going to buy a bigger one for the house.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: I live in a condo and it’s great for my patio! Convenient and it stores perfectly out of site
Results.Title: Love this bbq

Results.ReviewText: Makes grilling so easy, wished I would’ve spent the extra money years ago. Cooking and cleaning so easy.
Results.Title: Great gas grill!

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use and to store in camper. Easy clean up also. I recommend this grill for anyone that want a small grill and easy storage
Results.Title: Q1200 gas grill

Results.ReviewText: Purchased our Weber at Ace Hardware, and at first I was a little skeptical due to the size.  The reason I say this is that we just moved from a huge 4 bedroom home with a 1/4 acre backyard and sold our large grill.  When we set it up and used it for the first time I couldn't believe it.  I swear it's 100% better than our large grill.  It heats up super fast and cooks our steaks/burgers/hot dogs/whatever perfectly.  This has to be the BEST grill that we have ever owned.  Thank you Weber for putting this grill out.
Results.Title: Fantastic Purchase!

Results.ReviewText:
This is a great little grill. The only downside that I’ve found is that even on its lowest setting it’s still really hot. Difficult to cook bone in skin on chicken without burning up the skin. An even better alternative would be if it had dual burners so I could cook on one side indirect. 

Other than that I am very happy with this grill. Works excellent for cooking steaks, burgers, brats, etc. Just no so great for skin on chicken.
Results.Title: Wish it had a lower heat setting

Results.ReviewText: It lights with the starter. Its very well made. Its relatively easy to clean. I have never had a problem with the gas controller. This is my 3rd one. I had to move a couple of times and left it behind for the buyers. If you want an easy grill this is it. I have cooked steaks for eight on it so it will work in a larger group if you are creative.
Results.Title: Reliable

Results.ReviewText: Great product and outstanding quality.  Easy to use.
Results.Title: Great Product

Results.ReviewText:
I purchased this grill for road trips and camping. It has since found a home on our back deck and is now our go to grill. Might have to buy another for camping and road trips.
Cheers!
Results.Title: Simple, portable, functional!

Results.ReviewText: I have always tended to buy BBQ's bigger than I actually needed.  This time I opted for the Webber 1200 and it is the perfect size for my wife and I and even the occasional guest.  It starts on the first click, and maintains an even heat throughout the cooking cycle.  It is well made and attractive; we opted for the Orange color.
Results.Title: Perfect Size

Results.ReviewText: I bought this about a month ago and I love it.  My wife and I are in our 70's and this Weber Q 1200 Gas Grill is perfect for us. It is small and is easy to handle.
Results.Title: cooking out

Results.ReviewText: The worst grill I ever owned. I would very much like to return it.  I already did an exchange with the store (Lands End in Provincetown)...they won't take it back,  The gnition is awful...it takes up to a half a can of fuel to get it started (and two store employees had the same problem when they visited here with the second grill).  And even when ignoted...it will not heat past 375 degrees.   The Grill is a lemon!  I have owned other Weber grill's in the past.  NEVER a problem.   This one should not even have your name on it.
Results.Title: Worst grill I ever owned.  I want to return it.

Results.ReviewText: This is my third Q grill and have loved all of them. They cook very evenly due to the thick grates. They are easy to clean up and I like how the 1200 breaks down to put into our dock box with ease.
Results.Title: Awesome BBQ

Results.ReviewText: It’s Great for burgers and franks but don’t put a good cut of steak on it. It has 650 on the temperature gauge. I can’t get it hotter than 500 even after Weber sent a new regulator. Weber makes great grills. This one just does not get hot enough for the way I cook.
Results.Title: Won’t get hot enough to cook a steak right

Results.ReviewText: You get what you pay for! As a full time Rv traveler, I went through three other grills before the Q1200. It just works and easy to clean up after use.
Results.Title: You get what you pay for l

Results.ReviewText: I received this grill for my birthday and have used it twice now. The first time was for a student field trip (picnic) and was great for hot dogs and hamburgers for a large group. The second time was for grilling for two and it was a perfect size for that as well. My favorite part though - cleanup! Super easy!! We just let the grill cool down after using it and brought the grates right inside the house to wash off in the kitchen sink. So convenient!
Results.Title: Perfect for Two

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill. I will never own anything other than a Weber. Costumers service was wonderful
Results.Title: Prefect for my camping trips
